releaseNotes:
🛡️ 100% Data Preservation & Auto-Recovery Fix (v1.0.9) by Dhiraj:
• 🔒 Zero-Data-Loss Architecture: Destructive migration disabled; Room automatically checks and patches missing columns on-the-fly without touching existing messages
• 🔄 Auto-Recovery Engine: Automatically detects and restores any detached database copies
• 🌟 Web Developer Dashboard Live Reviews: User ratings & feedback now stream live to Dhiraj's Developer Dashboard with audio chimes and real-time metrics!
• ⚡ Unified Package ID: In-app updates now seamlessly update the installed app in-place without creating duplicate app icons
